name: smwgraphics-super-mario-bros-styled-statues
title: Super Mario Bros. Styled Statues
description:
Some statues base off of sprites from SMB1.

Sprites in the pack are...

1. Super Mario Walking
2. Super Mario Standing
3. Small Mario Jumping
4. Small Maroo Standing
5. Goomber
6. Mushroom
7. Fire Flower
8. Ground block
9. Chains

Putting the Statues on the Ground Blocks is recommended.

Comes in Purple and Grey.
Credit is not needed.
